events.title: PHOSPHOR 1.0 - Launch & Updates
events.summary: Hey everyone,PHOSPHOR 1.0 is here, and it's the biggest update the game has ever had. There's new stuff to find, the first hour is a lot friendlier, and most of the enemies you'll fight have been redrawn from scratch. Here's what changedFirst, a fresh start1.0 resets everyone's progress, one time only. events.title: PHOSPHR Demo is Now Live!
events.summary: The PHOSPHOR demo is finally here. This is an early build, and it's going to be rough around the edges. That's intentional. Right now, I need players to break things, find problems, test weapons, push the limits, and tell me what works — and what doesn't. Your feedback during this demo is going to directly shape PHOSPHOR as it moves toward its full release on October 31st. events.title: Balancing and Scaling Update V2
events.summary: Balancing and Scaling Update V2 Most of this update came out of one complaint, and it's one we agreed with. About halfway into a run, new guns stop mattering. You find something, you look at the card, you run the numbers in your head, and you put it back. Not because the gun is bad. It's because the one in your hands has eaten four wheel spins and six fusions, and the new one hasn't. We went and measured it, and it was worse than it felt.
